title: Grilled Chicken & Avocado Club Sandwich
description: Grilled Chicken & Avocado Club Sandwich is a premium continental sandwich layered with juicy grilled chicken, creamy avocado, crisp vegetables, melted cheese, and garlic aioli between toasted artisan bread. This professional chef's recipe delivers a perfectly balanced combination of textures and flavors for a top restaurant-quality meal.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken
items: ½ tsp black pepper, freshly ground

ingredients.title: For the Sandwich
items: 6 slices artisanal sourdough or multigrain bread (lightly toasted)
4–6 strips crispy smoked bacon (optional, for non-veg version)
2 tbsp garlic aioli (or mayonnaise with a touch of roasted garlic purée)
A handful of microgreens (arugula or baby spinach)

instruction.title: Prepare the Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken breasts with olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, pepper, and salt.
Grill on medium-high heat for 4–5 minutes per side until cooked through and slightly charred.
Rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly on a bias.

instruction.title: Toast the Bread
steps: Lightly butter and toast the bread slices until golden and crisp on the edges.

instruction.title: Assemble the Layers
steps: Base slice: Spread garlic aioli, top with lettuce, tomato, and sliced chicken.
Middle slice: Add Dijon mustard, avocado slices, cheese, and bacon (if using).
Top slice: Spread a thin layer of aioli, place on top, and press gently.

instruction.title: Finishing Touch
steps: Secure with bamboo picks or skewers.
Slice diagonally into halves or quarters.
Serve with a side of truffle fries or a small mixed salad.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve with a side of truffle fries or a small mixed salad.

chefTips: Replace chicken with grilled portobello mushrooms for a vegetarian option.
Use freshly baked sourdough or pain de campagne for a true continental flair.
A touch of pickled red onions elevates acidity and balances the richness.
